interpretation: Retain every positive-area overlap from the exact CEUR 2010 V2025-1 source geography to the exact CEUR 2022 V2025-1 target geography. Multiplicity and two-sided overlap shares are facts; illustrative stable/split/merge/complex labels live only in the separately versioned examples artifact.
known_limitations: Twelve source-invalid CEUR 2010 polygons remain visible as invalid source relation rows and are not repaired.
Thirteen source-invalid CEUR 2022 polygons are excluded from the analytical target set and counted explicitly in QA.
Positive area and overlap shares are geometric facts in EPSG:6933, not population allocation, transfer weights, ownership shares, or statistical weights.
Equal COD_2010/COD_2022 strings are recorded as an identity coincidence only; geometry agreement is evaluated separately from two-sided overlap shares.
The examples artifact is a versioned derived interpretation for inspection. It is not a crosswalk, exhaustive transition taxonomy, or assignment policy.
No make_valid, snapping, buffering, nearest assignment, canonical-boundary choice, or geometry substitution is applied.
